dependencyDashboardHeader: Tracks GitHub Actions and container image updates. Pending age checks are intentional; no updates are auto-merged.
dependencyDashboardFooter: Dex uses GHCR, which does not expose a release timestamp Renovate can verify. See the Dependency updates available issue for upstream Dex releases; image digest age still requires manual review.

packageRules.description: Workflows must pin full semver (v4.4.0), not floating majors (v4)
pinDigest freezes the full semver tag already in use. Those updates have no release timestamp, so timestamp-required leaves renovate/stability-days pending. Semver bumps keep the seven-day age.

Stay on python 3.14.x-slim, below 3.15. PEP 440 rejects the -slim suffix, and an npm range such as <3.15 treats -slim as a prerelease, so neither can see patch bumps. Docker versioning compares the numeric prefix and keeps the suffix.
